routeSelectors.audience: new and returning commercial visitors
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Omit thesis or metrics that are not CONTENT_READY, keep a governed empty media chamber when no approved render exists, show evidence unavailable only from the evidence contract, and omit commerce until the runtime projection resolves.

routeSelectors.audience: commercial browsers comparing entry products
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Use an unpopulated chamber for missing media, omit unready narrative and facts, and use explicit unavailable states without substituting another product.
forbidden: universal TESTED or THIRD PARTY chips

routeSelectors.audience: customers browsing, filtering or searching the range
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Unknown filters are ignored per the taxonomy contract, missing card facts are omitted, and ambiguous identity removes the product from the commerce projection until resolved.
forbidden: deriving form or servings from Woo prose

routeSelectors.module: PDP hero and first-fold purchase decision
routeSelectors.audience: customers making a product decision
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Keep media chamber empty when unbound, render em dash only in stable metric anatomy, omit unready thesis, present evidence unavailable from OpenLab, and suppress purchase action if commerce is unresolved.

routeSelectors.audience: detail-oriented customers reviewing exact product format
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Omit absent composition rows, preserve an explicit unavailable fact value only where the component anatomy requires it, and never fill from a related product or editorial prose.
forbidden: static interactive-tab claims when the surface is non-interactive

routeSelectors.module: PDP evidence snapshot and dossier evidence link
routeSelectors.audience: customers seeking record-specific product evidence
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Render the explicit unavailable or partial evidence boundary; do not show a record CTA, analytical value or verified label without an applicable record binding.

routeSelectors.audience: customers comparing a legitimate next product decision
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Omit an unapproved relationship edge; never synthesize STACKS WELL WITH from a related-product array alone.

routeSelectors.module: OpenLab portal, wayfinding and record archive
routeSelectors.audience: customers browsing the evidence register
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Show no-results or unavailable state without did-you-mean substitution; omit global metrics unless the current OpenLab projection supplies their exact semantic basis.

routeSelectors.audience: customers connecting one product to its available evidence
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Use partial or unavailable product experience; no cloned MK-2866 data and no enabled source action without a bound record.

routeSelectors.audience: customers inspecting a named record or batch
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Show UnavailableEvidencePanel with no fallback result, no replacement record and no source-generation claim.
forbidden: claiming a provider file is present without the OpenLab source action

routeSelectors.module: OpenLab CoA and evidence document viewer
routeSelectors.audience: customers opening a source-connected evidence document
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Render document unavailable; do not display a viewer, filename, provider-status message or download action without a bound source document.
forbidden: live fetch in the presentation candidate

routeSelectors.audience: customers assembling a non-prescriptive product bundle
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Disable selection for unresolved commerce or identity; omit unsupported rationale and evidence instead of substituting generic benefit language.
forbidden: claiming this candidate path is a new canonical ledger route

routeSelectors.audience: customers comparing product roles without personal regimen advice
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Hide relationship choices lacking CONTENT_READY rationale; an unavailable evidence state remains visible and does not block factual comparison unless the edge requires evidence.

routeSelectors.audience: customers comparing exact product formats or evidence paths
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Render an em dash or unavailable state in the affected cell; do not rank, impute or normalize missing facts.

routeSelectors.audience: customers at explicitly sanctioned continuation points
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Omit the recommendation when rationale, identity or commerce binding is unavailable; do not fall back to a generic bestseller.
forbidden: use on payment, processing, order-pay, failure or retry

routeSelectors.audience: customers learning how to read product and evidence information
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Use source-checking or unavailable copy only when that wording is CONTENT_READY; otherwise omit the incomplete educational module.

routeSelectors.audience: customers seeking product, evidence or service help
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Omit an unapproved answer and route the customer to general contact support; do not improvise policy, delivery or product guidance.

routeSelectors.module: bag line-item product identity and sanctioned continuation
routeSelectors.audience: customers reviewing selected items before checkout
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Preserve order/cart identity from its owner projection, omit optional static facts and media, and suppress continuation if its relationship is not CONTENT_READY.
forbidden: evidence status unrelated to the line

routeSelectors.audience: customers confirming which product is in the order
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Use the checkout/order owner identity; omit optional alias or render if registry binding is unavailable and never block payment on optional content.

routeSelectors.audience: customers reviewing a completed order or returning to their account
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Order identity remains from the order owner; omit continuation entirely if rationale or commerce state is unavailable.
forbidden: continuation on pending, failed or cancelled result

routeSelectors.audience: customers completing, waiting for or recovering a transaction
routeSelectors.missingContentBehavior: Not applicable: product-content absence is intentional and must not trigger a fallback module.
forbidden: product facts beyond necessary order identity
